sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 475 physical subject rows / 458 family-card identities across 12 sections retain original Name/Team/Rookie cells, 150 numeric base entries, 189 literal Rookie marks and both signers on 17 dual cards. Historical team names, original spellings and card-specific blank Rookie cells are preserved. All 84 Hobby odds retain literal values, including Base 3:1 and Rookie 2:1; the sheet states no ratio unit. Four exact pull-report card examples and the unnamed-parallel Jaxson Dart ten-copy example stay card-specific without numbering entire families. The official launch article explicitly announces July 10, 2026; product year 2025 and store Product Year 2026 remain separate. Exhaustive parallel numbering remains unverified.

Exhaustive parallel numbering remains unverified. No base-wide numeric ladder is established by the checked official product-specific pages; other sports, other Chrome products and color names do not establish limits.
Four pull-report examples apply only to PBDA-DMTB, PBDA-JDCW, IA-JD and BL-6. The Orange /25 heading and copy-limit body remain qualified; no family-wide numbering is inferred.
The launch article numbers Jaxson Dart Rookie Autograph to ten copies without naming its parallel; keep this RAU-JD example separate from all odds names.
The Hobby heading names a format but no ratio unit; Base 3:1 and Rookie 2:1 remain literal, without computed pack rates.

Original flags are card-specific: Cam Ward on PBDA-JDCW and Luther Burden III on PBDA-CWLB are blank despite printed Rookie marks elsewhere. Historical Houston Oilers and Los Angeles Raiders names and SFA-THE TREVEYON spelling remain unchanged.
